Hi Alicia / Samir —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We want to get the initial implementation/ops kickoff on the calendar so your teams can be aligned on roles, network/access, and success criteria. Proposed windows (all PT):

- Option A: Friday May 10, 2029 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Option B: Monday May 13, 2029 — 08:30–10:00 PT

Agenda (draft, attached): 30m overview + 40m technical owners + 20m next steps / MAP. I attached a first-pass agenda and our mutual action plan; please review and let us know if anything critical is missing.

Attendee ask from your side: product owner, infra/network lead (for VPC peering / firewall rules), and a business sponsor if possible. We’ll be joining with: myself (CS lead), Monica (implementation manager), Ben (solutions engineer), and Jonas (support for infra checklist).

Logistics notes:
- We’ll use the Zoom bridge below; if your security team requires an alternative (vendor-managed bridge), flag it and we’ll adapt.
- Please confirm which timezone the attendees prefer if the windows above are tight.

If you confirm a preferred window I’ll have Monica send the calendar invite with links, dial-in and a short pre-read.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
